Patients requiring only occasional relief from symptoms may be man- aged with an inhaled short-acting beta2 agonist, and an inhaled corticosteroid such as fluticasone is added if symptomatic relief is needed more than once daily. In more severe asthma other drugs may be added (combination with a long-acting beta2 ago- nist may have synergistic benefits), or the dose of inhaled corti- costeroid may be increased.
